# `settings` operations

2 operations. Generated from `assets/operations.json`; [all areas](README.md).

### settings.get

**Settings**

Read configured tool locations and update settings.

Annotations: read-only, idempotent, open world.

Takes no arguments.

```sh
tomaccoctl call settings.get
```

### settings.configure

**Set up toolchain**

Configure SDK, JDK and executable paths without installing or running them, how updates behave, and how many heavy jobs run at once.

Annotations: writes, idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `android_sdk` | string |  |  | non-empty; Absolute local filesystem path |
| `java_home` | string |  |  | non-empty; Absolute local filesystem path |
| `android_ndk` | string |  |  | non-empty; Absolute local filesystem path |
| `swift_android_sdk` | string |  |  | Installed Swift Android SDK identifier |
| `executables` | object |  |  | Tool name to absolute executable path |
| `updates` | object |  |  | Update behaviour |
| `updates.mode` | string |  |  | one of `off`, `notify`, `auto`; off: no request unless the user asks. notify: check once a day and tell the user. auto: also install when idle. |
| `updates.channel` | string |  |  | one of `stable`, `prerelease`; stable (default): GitHub's latest release. prerelease: also releases GitHub marks as pre-releases. |
| `updates.token_file` | string |  |  | Owner-only file with a GitHub token, for a private repository; empty removes it |
| `jobs` | object |  |  | How many heavy jobs run at once; more wait as queued with a reason. 0 means no limit |
| `jobs.max_builds` | integer |  |  | 0 to 64; Builds and deploys (project.execute, project.run except Flutter sessions, ios.flutter_build); 2 by default |
| `jobs.max_emulators` | integer |  |  | 0 to 64; Android emulators started with android.avd_start, for as long as they run; no limit by default |

```sh
tomaccoctl call settings.configure
```
